prompt: For whom are two places held each session?
promptZh: 每場活動的兩個名額是保留給誰？
evidence: two are held for callers who cannot use the booking page

options.text: People unable to use the online booking page.
options.zh: 無法使用線上預約頁面的人。
options.whyZh: 這類來電者有保留名額。

options.text: People attending without a reservation holder.
options.zh: 未與預約人一同到場的人。
options.why: Companion access has a separate name rule.
options.whyZh: 同行者另有事先提供姓名的規定。

options.text: People arriving late for the indoor demonstration.
options.zh: 遲到的室內示範參加者。
options.why: The two places are set aside at booking, not for late arrivals.
options.whyZh: 這兩個名額在受理預約時即保留，不是留給遲到者。

options.text: People who bring their own kites.
options.why: Equipment is unrelated to these places.
options.whyZh: 自備器材與這兩個名額無關。
